rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Neither pinned snapshot contains an exact Labyrinthulomycetes root. The similarly named Labyrinthulea candidates are not substituted: COL DJ is already entirely within Bigyra, while ITIS TSN 46076 sits below Mycetozoa. No row-level crosswalk or ITIS-only partition is asserted.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar records a zero-row exact-root audit for Labyrinthulomycetes. It does not substitute the conflicting nearby Labyrinthulea classifications or duplicate the existing Bigyra partition. It is not a global checklist, classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.
